correctness.rationale: Independently recomputed from scratch: 2^8 enumeration gives the same 8 minimal covers, all size 5, all column sums 5. Waldschmidt averaging proof is valid (5 deg>=8m; diagonal (k..k) gives matching upper bound, Fekete applies). Exhaustive degree search confirms alpha=(2,4,5,7,8) and both witnesses satisfy all 8 cover inequalities. Box lemma proof is sound (a_v>=m+1 allows subtracting e_v). Own numpy rerun: 390625 vectors, 358134 in I^(4), 316 unique 3-edge loads, zero counterexamples, so I^(4) subset I^3 holds. Spot-checked (2,2),(3,2),(5,4) hold and (3,3),(4,4) fail by degree. Diagonal family proves rho>=5/4; rho=rho_a=5/4 is honestly fenced as conjecture.

originality.rationale: EMERGENT_FINDING genuinely arose from the target investigation (proved core of the admitted target: Waldschmidt plus I^(4) vs I^3 for M8). Fused three-direction literature search plus full-text inspection of the nearest priors shows no prior states or implies the M8-specific package: cubic-circulant paper covers only regularity; unicyclic decomposition does not apply to multicycle M8; Villarreal/Bocci give general LP/duality methods, not the M8 values or the finite containment certificate. Exact M8 constants, witnesses, and certificate are not in a table or database.

value.rationale: Exact invariants (Waldschmidt 8/5, alpha sequence, proved I^(4) subset I^3 with complete finite certificate, companion containment/failure table, proved rho>=5/4) of the natural, pre-motivated Wagner M8 edge ideal. Values were unknown, not mechanically implied, and are precisely the facts a future researcher on symbolic powers, resurgence, or cubic circulants would need to retrieve. This is an eligible exact-value/benchmark finding under STANDARD, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, or unexplained enumeration; the unfinished rho upper bound is fenced as conjecture and does not erase the headline result.

Bocci et al. Waldschmidt constant for squarefree monomial ideals (J Algebraic Combin 44, 2016): abstract, methods, and references inspected; general LP/fractional-chromatic method, no M8 value.

Independent recomputation in audit execution environment: brute-force covers, column sums, witness cover sums, exhaustive min-degree search, and independent I^(4)-vs-I^3 domination check against all 316 loads.

perplexity_final_check.rationale: The terminal check returned 20 results (5 overlapping the base set, 15 new) with full provider coverage. The 5 overlaps merely duplicate base providers (regularity cubic-circulant paper, unicyclic symbolic-powers paper, author page). Of the 15 new URLs, 8 yielded substantively relevant same-object or same-method leads after literal comparison and all were opened in full and excluded above with body-level theorem, example, table, or parameter-search evidence; none states or implies the M8-specific 8/5, alpha 2-4-5-7-8, 358134-monomial I^(4) certificate, or 5/4 package. Remaining new URLs were triaged as different objects or disjoint scopes: whisker graphs (different vertex counts), Cohen-Macaulay/regularity/depth/Stanley-depth circulant papers on other graph classes without symbolic content, the Galway student slides (3449 extracted characters, chordal focus, no symbolic terms), the Thanh Vu author listing page, and the arXiv-abs duplicate of the regularity paper. The NUST-repository PDF triaged as a possible thesis was attempted via two HTTP clients and webfetch (transport failures); its cached title and snippet scope it to Depth/Stanley Depth/Regularity with no Waldschmidt, resurgence, symbolic-power, or containment parameters, and its document type as a dissertation is unconfirmed from cached fields, so it is not a plausibly-covering escalation. No UNRESOLVED candidate remains and no COVERS_CLAIM source exists; originality PASS is preserved with correctness and value untouched and the public package intact.
